lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You're not watching me well enough.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: Honor is just the story the strong tell about why they get to stay strong.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: Honor is the story the weak tell so the strong don't crush them. It serves everyone.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: High praise from a man who measures everything in usefulness.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: I measure everything in results. Usefulness is just the path.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You fight like you have something to prove.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: Everyone does. The ones who say otherwise are lying.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: My brother would have liked you. He had no patience for rules either.
